article.title: PATRICK LAWRENCE: Diana Johnstone—A Tribute
article.author: Patrick Lawrence
article.content: She was one of those few who brought honor to our profession, a mostly dishonorable profession, and permitted one some measure of pride for being part of it. The post PATRICK LAWRENCE: Diana Johnstone—A Tribute appeared first on MR Online .
